title: crypto2dev TLS: SSL_CTX devId assignment helper
description: Implement wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(WOLFSSL_CTX* ctx) and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl(WOLFSSL* ssl) helper functions that correctly configure a wolfSSL context to use crypto2dev for supported operations. The helper must: (1) call wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice() if not already done, (2) set wolfSSL_CTX_SetDevId(ctx, WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) for session keys, (3) explicitly set INVALID_DEVID for any hash types that require Copy (transcript hash objects) — this may require using wolfSSL's per-hash devId override if available, or documenting that transcript hashes will fall back to software. Also implement wc_crypto2dev_unassign_devid() cleanup.
notes: SSL_CTX devId propagates to all WOLFSSL objects created from it via wolfSSL_new(). The key challenge is distinguishing transcript hashes (must be software) from Finished MAC hashes (can be hardware). Currently wolfSSL does not have a per-use devId override — the devId is set on the wc_Sha256 object, and both transcript and HMAC use the same object type. Workaround: only use hardware for HMAC (WC_ALGO_TYPE_HMAC), not for streaming hash (WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH). Document this in the helper.
